purpose: 建立可按历史时点复算的市场风险与股价隐含预期指标；检验价值加低波在50万元以内的稳健性。

capital_experiment.later_risk_experiment: Freeze the baseline first; separately test local implied-volatility overlays. Report exposure-matched results.
constraints: Do not increase participation assumptions to make scaling appear successful.
Use the same data cutoff and execution model across capital levels.
Complete missing-year replay and align historical execution methods before claiming five-year robustness.

shared_contract.point_in_time_rule: An input is usable only when its available_at is no later than the decision cutoff. Preserve financial-statement revisions; never backdate newly collected material.
shared_contract.missing_data: Return unavailable with reason; never silently substitute zero, current data, or future revisions.

local_implied_volatility.purpose: Market risk state and candidate portfolio exposure overlay; does not predict return direction.
local_implied_volatility.underlying_selection: Audit broad-market ETF/index option-chain history; prefer alignment with the current CSI500-based stock pool. Record basis risk explicitly.
local_implied_volatility.identity: Local research IV30; do not label as the official Cboe VIX or an official Chinese index.
local_implied_volatility.method: Use a documented option-strip variance method per expiry, then interpolate total variance between eligible expiries bracketing 30 calendar days; annualize consistently and take the square root.
local_implied_volatility.calendar_basis: Record calendar, exact settlement timestamps, timezone and annualization convention; do not copy US expiry-selection rules without adapting them.
quality_checks: Synchronize quotes and reject stale/crossed/invalid quotes.
Handle zero bids and option-wing truncation with a versioned rule.
Require sufficient strike coverage and two eligible maturities bracketing the target; no silent extrapolation.
Exclude or normalize adjusted contracts consistently.
Persist all excluded contracts and reasons.
local_implied_volatility.realized_volatility_fallback: Keep realized volatility as a separately named feature; it is not VIX and cannot replace missing historical option chains.
local_implied_volatility.us_vix: Optional external risk input; use only the US observation actually available at the China decision cutoff.

reverse_dcf.purpose: Estimate the operating expectations implied by market price under explicit assumptions; not a unique observable market forecast.
reverse_dcf.initial_scope: Nonfinancial companies with interpretable operating cash flows; route financial firms and unsuitable negative/unstable cash-flow cases to separate models.
reverse_dcf.solve_for: One variable at a time, initially revenue CAGR.
reverse_dcf.valuation_identity: Operating enterprise value equals discounted FCFF over the explicit horizon plus discounted terminal value; reconcile consistently to equity value.
reverse_dcf.reinvestment_rule: Growth must be paired with reinvestment assumptions; do not assume incremental revenue is free cash flow.
solver_rules: Record search bounds, residual and convergence.
Return no_solution or multiple_solutions when appropriate.
Require terminal discount rate above terminal growth in a perpetual-growth terminal model.
reverse_dcf.interpretation: Compare implied requirements with independently evidenced business scenarios; low implied growth alone is not a buy signal.

acceptance_checks: Known DCF inputs -> synthetic price -> recover the same unique input within tolerance.
Reject invalid terminal assumptions and report unsolved/multiple-root cases.
Verify volatility interpolation, units, stale quotes and missing maturity handling with independent fixtures.
Truncating data at a historical cutoff must not change any earlier output.
Run fee and liquidity stress tests and report risk/exposure changes, not only return.
Keep hypotheses frozen before new validation; do not describe already-inspected years as untouched holdouts.
